scripts.start-hot-league:with-sso-controls: cd seal-monorepo && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SIMULATOR_CONFIG="{\"simulationMode\":{\"enabled\":true},\"simulatorConfigs\":{\"enabled\":true,\"defaultGameType\":\"rng-soccer\"}}" nx serve hot-league-wall --port=4201
scripts.start-hot-league:no-sso-controls: cd seal-monorepo && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SIMULATOR_CONFIG="{\"simulationMode\":{\"enabled\":false},\"simulatorConfigs\":{\"enabled\":false,\"defaultGameType\":\"rng-soccer\"}}" nx serve hot-league-wall --port=4202
scripts.test-env-vars: cd seal-monorepo/libs/hot-league-wall && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SIMULATOR_CONFIG="{\"simulationMode\":{\"enabled\":true},\"simulatorConfigs\":{\"enabled\":true,\"defaultGameType\":\"rng-soccer\"}}" node test-env-vars.js
scripts.test-sso-controls:enabled: cd seal-monorepo/libs/hot-league-wall && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SIMULATOR_CONFIG="{\"simulationMode\":{\"enabled\":true},\"simulatorConfigs\":{\"enabled\":true,\"defaultGameType\":\"rng-soccer\"}}" node -e "console.log('Should show SSO controls: true')"
scripts.test-sso-controls:disabled: cd seal-monorepo/libs/hot-league-wall && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SIMULATOR_CONFIG="{\"simulationMode\":{\"enabled\":false},\"simulatorConfigs\":{\"enabled\":false,\"defaultGameType\":\"rng-soccer\"}}" node -e "console.log('Should show SSO controls: false')"
